Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are already out in the midle now. Amy Hunter and Gaby Lewis are the two openers for Ireland Women. Renuka Singh to start proceedings with the new ball for India Women. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, India Women have posted a good total on the board and their bowlers will like to use the wind to their advantage to defend this total and confirm their semi-final spot. Ireland Women know that chasing this will not be an easy task, but they have some quality batters and if they play well, they can get over the line here and get their first win of the tournament. Let's see how the chase unfolds.

Laura Delany is up for a quick-chat. She says that the conditions were tricky to assess at first. Adds that there might be some turn on offer but other than that it looks good. Informs that they will try to make the most of the wind just like India Women. Mentions that they will certainly come out with an intent to get over the line here.

Ireland Women should be satisfied with their bowling effort, but their woes in the field continued which made a huge difference in the total. Although they took a couple of good catches, overall they were ordinary and dropped a few too many chances. And when you give this many chances to a quality batter like , Smriti Mandhana, you would always get punished. Orla Prendergast was the pick of the bowlers with three wickets while their skipper, Laura Delany also picked up three scalps as well. Now, it is time for their batters to step up if they want to cause an upset.

India Women got off to slow but steady start. Both openers tried to focus more on not losing a wicket and they ended up scoring just 42 runs in the Powerplay. Smriti Mandhana then tried to attack and luck was on her side as she got a few lives due to some poor fielding from the Irish. Shafali Verma got out trying to up the ante after putting up a 62-run opening stand. Harmanpreet Kaur struggled on this wicket and got dismissed after eating up a few too many balls and not scoring much and then Richa Ghosh followed her and lost her wicket for the first time in this tournament. However, Smriti Mandhana held one end and after getting to her fifty, she went full attacking and smashed the bowlers all around the park. She ended up scoring 87 runs off just 56 balls and in the end a quick-fire knock form Jemimah Rodrigues got them past the 150-run mark to give their bowlers plenty to play with.

A good contest with bat and ball comes to an end! India Women have managed to get past the 150-run mark, but they know that they could have got more. Ireland Women will think that they let this get away from them as they had their moments to restrict India Women to lower total than this but could not capitalise on them.

OUT! STUMPED! Ireland Women end their innings on a positive note. A slower length ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues uses her feet and tries to launch it down the park but misses. She comes way outside the crease. Mary Waldron is quick to take the bails off. Excellent wicket-keeping. India Women end their innings at 155/6.
Commentary.Howout: st Mary Waldron b Arlene Kelly

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good shot. Jemimah Rodrigues dances down the track and plays a lofted drive over covers for four runs.
Kelly serves it full and on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues gets low and works it towards wide of long on. They collect a brace.
It is much fuller, on off. It turns away a bit. Jemimah Rodrigues tries to smack it through the line but misses.
A length ball, on fifth stump. Jemimah Rodrigues goes way down the leg side to create some room and in the end fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Nicely played. Jemimah Rodrigues starts the final over on a positive now. It is full, on leg. Jemimah Rodrigues gets low and whips it through square leg for four runs.
Arlene Kelly (3-0-18-0) to bowl the last over.
Fuller one and on middle, Pooja Vastrakar whips it with the inner half wide of deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
Pooja Vastrakar comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Orla Prendergast gets two in two. Deepti Sharma holes out on a golden duck. Goes full and on middle. Deepti Sharma hangs back and tries to flick it away. Although she is a bit early into her shot. The ball takes the leading edge and chips towards cover. Georgina Dempsey steps forward and takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Georgina Dempsey b Orla Prendergast

Commentary.Commentary: Deepti Sharma is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Orla Prendergast now gets herself into the wicket's column. The players are delighted to see the back of Smriti Mandhana here. It is full and on off. Smriti Mandhana gets under it and launches it down the ground. Gaby Lewis stays calm in the deep and takes a sharp catch in front of her eyes.
Commentary.Howout: c Gaby Lewis b Orla Prendergast

Commentary.Commentary: Orla Prendergast goes full, wide outside off. Infact it is near the tramline. Jemimah Rodrigues shuflles a long way across and sweeps it to square leg for one.
Another single now as this is driven towards sweeper cover.
Slower one, wide of off. Jemimah Rodrigues reaches out and helps it towards deep point. One taken.
Jemimah Rodrigues gets down on one knee and sweeps this full one to deep mid-wicket. It meets the fielder on a bounce. Single taken.
LEG BYE! It is full and on leg. Smriti Mandhana misses her flick. It goes through her legs and past the keeper. They collect a leg bye.

SIX! Smriti Mandhana is on fire. It is pitched up, on fourth stump. Smriti Mandhana shuffles across and dispatches it across the line. Once again she hits it into the win and it breezes over the fence.
Delany follows the batter down leg. Jemimah Rodrigues clips it towards mid on and rotates the strike.
A single now as this is worked down to long on.
FOUR! The ball just bounces before the ropes. Smriti Mandhana moves to 79. It is full and in the slot. Smriti Mandhana gets low and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket. Boundary.
Length and on off. Mandhana punches it to the off side for one run.

FOUR! Dropped in the deep. It is full, down leg. Smriti Mandhana makes room and lofts it towards sweeper cover. The fielder in the deep fails to judge the ball as it is hit into the wind. The ball hits her and rolls to the fence, as she overruns it.
A single now as this is worked to point.
FOUR! Nicely played. Fuller, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues leans in front and clips it through mid-wicket for four runs.
Floated, full and on off, Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and drills it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it firmly towards covers.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks out to bat now. Also, Arlene Kelly (2-0-7-0) comes back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! WOW! Laura Delany is doing the job for her side single-handedly here. She gets her third wicket of the innings. Richa Ghosh gets dismissed for the first time in this tournament. It is fuller and on off. Richa Ghosh gets low and heaves it down towards long on. She does not get the desired connection on it. Gaby Lewis takes a solid catch here.
Commentary.Howout: c Gaby Lewis b Laura Delany

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! This is spilled down leg. The umpire signals a wide.
Richa Ghosh comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Harmanpreet Kaur now tries to join the party but instead kills the music here. A huge wicket for Ireland Women and it is the skipper once again who has an impact with the ball. It is full and on off. Kaur launches it towards deep mid-wicket but does not get the desired distance on it. Orla Prendergast runs in from the deep and takes a solid catch diving forward.
Commentary.Howout: c Orla Prendergast b Laura Delany

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
SIX! Solid shot! 50-run stand also comes up with this maximum. It is full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana gets low and slogs it over the deep mid-wicket fence.
Delany follows the batter down leg with a full one. Kaur drills it down to long on for one.
Tossed up, full and on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it firmly towards covers.
Back of a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur guides it towards short third man.
Overpitched and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it firmly but straight to covers.
Georgina Dempsey follows the batter and bowls this full, on leg, Smriti Mandhana gets cramped and misses her flick as the ball goes off her pads towards point. A leg bye is taken.
FOUR! Two in a row! This is full again and on leg, Smriti Mandhana makes room and drills it past the diving cover fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Georgina Dempsey serves this full and in the slot, on middle, Smriti Mandhana clears her front leg and thrashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Fuller one and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it through covers for a single

SIX! FIFTY FOR MANDHANA! She gets to it in style as well. This is her 22nd in T20Is and has come at a good time for India Women. This is flighted, full and on middle, Smriti Mandhana goes down and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep square leg for one.
Flighted, full and on off, turning away, Harmanpreet Kaur looks to cut it, but misses.
Flatter, short and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur tucks it towards short mid-wicket.

DROPPED AGAIN! Smriti Mandhana gets another life! This is floated and on leg, Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and tries to heave it, but miscues it in the air. Arlene Kelly runs across towards the mid-wicket region, dives to her left but spills it out. A single is taken.
Tossed up, full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes down and scoops it towards fine leg for a single.
A slower one now, full and on leg, Smriti Mandhana misses her flick and gets hit on her pads as the ball goes nowhere.
FOUR! Fine shot! Orla Prendergast serves this full and on off, Smriti Mandhana makes some room and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length and around off, angling away, Smriti Mandhana tries to got for the big shot, but misses.
Overpitched and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur heaves it towards deep square leg for one.
Another full delivery but down the leg side, Harmanpreet Kaur misses her flick. Wided.
Fuller again and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur clips it towards mid-wicket where a misfiled allows the second run. Harmanpreet Kaur completes 3000 runs T20I cricket!
Oh..that is close! Orla Prendergast serves this full and on off, shaping in, Harmanpreet Kaur swings across the line, but misses and the ball goes just past the off pole.
This is on a good length and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur moves back and punches it towards long on for another run. Smriti Mandhana collides with the bowler while starting the run, but no harm done.
A slower one now, full and around off, Smriti Mandhana drags it towards deep square leg for one more.
Full and outside off, way outside off, Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone. Wided.
Pitched up and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
A high full toss outside off, Smriti Mandhana smackes it towards sweeper covers for a run. She missed out there.
Fuller one and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur drills it towards long on for a run.
Tossed up and around off, Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and drives it through covers for a single.
Slightly shorter and around off, Smriti Mandhana mistimes her pull towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
FOUR! Good use of the feet! This is flighted and on middle, Smriti Mandhana skips down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Gives this one some air, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur makes room and guides it towards backward point for one.
Short and on middle, Smriti Mandhana moves across and heaves it on the bounce towards deep square leg for another run.
A low full toss, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it towards long on for a single.
Floated, short and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur turns it towards short mid-wicket.
A wicket-taking over by Delany comes to an end. It is full and on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to the off side.
Harmanpreet Kaur gets off the mark. It is full, on middle and leg. Kaur tucks it towards mid on and crosses.
On off, driven back to the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT! The Irish skipper gets herself into the attack and gets the breakthrough her side were after. Delany goes full, drifting down leg. Verma lunges and goes for the pick up shot, as she wrists it towards deep mid-wicket. Amy Hunter charges in from the deep, puts in a late dive forward and Amy Hunter takes a stunning catch. Ireland Women created a few chances in the last few overs but could not make the most it. Now, they would hope that they can build on this wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Hunter b Laura Delany

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks! India Women lose their first wicket just before the halfway mark and will need to build another partnership. Ireland Women will be happy that their pressure finally paid off, but they will away of the long batting line-up of the Indians. So, they need to continued this good work till the end of the innings. Also, Harmanpreet Kaur promotes herself and walks out to bat at number 3.
Fuller, on the pads. Verma clips it straight to mid-wicket.
It is a length ball, wide of off. Shafali Verma slashes hard but misses.
WIDE! Yet another loosener. Once again this is spilled down leg. Wided.
WIDE! Delany goes very full, sliding down leg. Verma gets low and tries to sweep it away but misses.
India Women are starting to get restless here and are trying to increase the scoring rate, but this wicket is turning out to be a difficult one.
Short and on off. Verma punches it through the line to the off side for a single.

Ireland Women create another opportunity but they have no luck on their side. It is full, on middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and throws her blade at it. The ball goes high up in the air towards long off. Three fielders are converging but it lands safely in the middle. One taken.
On off, defended out.
A single now as this is driven to covers.
FOUR! Powerfully hit! Paul drags her length back, on fifth stump. Verma goes on her back foot and punches it through the line. It goes through the gap at the cover region and into the fence.
This is very full, wide outside off, turning further away. Shafali Verma shuffles across and tries to smack it through the line but does not connect.
Change of ends for Leah Paul.
Floated, on leg. Verma nudges it to mid-wicket for one.

DROPPED! How costly will this prove to be? Smriti Mandhana is riding on her luck here. It is a juicy full toss, on off. Smriti Mandhana steps down and whips it to deep mid-wicket. She hits it straight down the throat of the fielder in the deep, but it is grassed. The batters cross for a single.
This is worked to the leg side for a single.
Fulll and on off. Smriti Mandhana lofts it to long off. It bounces before the fielder in the deep. They take one.
WIDE! This is full, spilled way outside the tramline, outside off.
Flatter and on off. Verma guides it to short third man and rotates the strike.
Aerial but safe! It is tossed up, around off. Smriti Mandhana miscues her shot this time but it luckily beats the mid on fielder who is tracking back. One taken.

Through the hands! Kelly serves it full and on off. Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and lofts it towards mid off. Fortunately, the fielder there is unable to get a hold of it. The batters take a single as the long on fielder comes across to recover it.
Fuller, on the pads. Verma tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, defended out.
This is short, on middle. Smriti Mandhana is cramped for room here. She goes back a bit and dabs it down to backward point and crosses.
On off, pushed gently towards mid off.
Looped up, full and outside off. Verma leans forward and checks her shot towards mid off. One taken.
FOUR! Lovely placement! It is tossed up, full and outside off. Smriti Mandhana dances down the track, opens the face and creams it past mid off. The ball has enough legs to reach the fence.
Verma rocks back and cuts this short ball to deep point for one.
FOUR! Smacked! It is a short one, wide of off. Shafali Verma shuffles and slaps it hard past extra covers. It races away to the fence.
It is full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana comes down the track and slices it over covers. Get enough on it to beat the fielders. One taken.
Gives it some flight this time, on off. Verma steps down and works it to long on for another single.
Floats it up, around middle. Smriti Mandhana sits deep in the crease and whips it to mid-wicket for one.
Length again and around leg, Smriti Mandhana nudges it through mid-wicket for one.
On a length and on middle, Shafali Verma flicks it towards square leg where the fielder makes a half-stop. They cross.
Three dots in a row! This is back of a length and outside off, Shafali Verma punches it straight to short covers.
Arlene Kelly continues bowling full, on off, Shafali Verma drills it towards mid off.
Fuller again and on middle, Shafali Verma mistimes her flick on the bounce towards short mid-wicket.
Arlene Kelly starts with a fuller delivery around off, Smriti Mandhana drives it towards sweeper covers for a single.
Change. Arlene Kelly comes into the attack now. She replaces Orla Prendergast.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is tucked towards mid-wicket by Smriti Mandhana.
This is pitched up, on off, Smriti Mandhana knocks it towards mid off.

Good fielding in the deep! Georgina Dempsey serves this full and down the leg again, Smriti Mandhana tickles it wide of fine leg where the fielder puts in a brilliant dive to her left to stop it from going over the fence. Two more runs added to the total.
Overpitched and down the leg side, Smriti Mandhana misses her flick. It is called a wide.
FOUR! Just over! Georgina Dempsey bowls this back of a length and on leg, Smriti Mandhana swivels and hooks it just over the leaping short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Full again and on leg, Smriti Mandhana lobs it wide of deep square leg where the fielder covers her ground and dives to her left to stop it. Two runs taken!
Fuller one and outside off, Shafali Verma slices it towards third man for a single.
On a length and on leg, shaping away, Smriti Mandhana looks to work it away, but closes the face of her bat early and gets a leading edge towards covers.
Orla Prendergast strays from her line and serves this full and outside off, way outside off, Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone. Wided.
Length again and on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Nice shot! Orla Prendergast bowls this on a hard length and around off, Smriti Mandhana takes a couple of steps forward and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Goes fuller this time and on off, Smriti Mandhana knocks it in front of cover-point.
Back of a length and outside off, angling away, Smriti Mandhana steers it towards point.
This is on a good length and around leg, Smriti Mandhana turns it towards short mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Georgina Dempsey bowls this on a good length and around off, shaping away, Shafali Verma tries to drive it on the up, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is pitched up, on off, Shafali Verma goes for the drive again, but gets a leading edge towards point.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Georgina Dempsey serves this full and outside off, Shafali Verma comes down the track and drives it wide of covers where the fielder dives to her left and gets a hand to it, but it still runs away for a boundary.
Pulls her length back a bit, on leg, Smriti Mandhana tucks it through square leg for a single.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Smriti Mandhana drills it back to the bowler.
Georgina Dempsey begins with a hard-length delivery dwon the leg, Smriti Mandhana paddles it past the keeper and the fielder from short fine leg chase it and just keeps it in. Two runs taken!
Georgina Dempsey to bowl from the other end.
Pitched up and on off again, Shafali Verma mistimes her drive back towards the left of the bowler.
Back of a length and on middle, Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it wide of deep square leg and takes on the arm of the fielder to complete three runs.
India Women and Shafali Verma are finally underway! This is fuller again and on middle, swinging in, Shafali Verma works it towards fine leg for a single.
A slower delivery now, full and around off, Shafali Verma pushes it towards covers.
Length again and on middle, shaping in, Shafali Verma nudges it towards square leg.
Orla Prendergast starts with a good-length delivery, on off, Shafali Verma cuts it straight to point.

Done with the pre-match formalities! The Ireland Women players spread out and take their respective field positions. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana walks out to open the innings for India Women. Orla Prendergast has the new ball in her hand and is raring to go. Let's play...
The match is set to begin. But first, the players line up for their respective national anthem. It will be Ireland's first, followed by the national anthem of India.

PITCH REPORT - Nasser Hussain is near the deck. He starts by saying that the sun is shining in all its glory.  Informs that the off-side for a right handed batter is 62m and the leg side is 57m. Anjum Chopra joins in and says that there is a grey patch and it is dry and it will be a good batting deck.

Laura Delany, the skipper of Ireland Women is in for a chat. She tells that they will try to put in their best performance and trust their process. Mentions the younger players are coming through and making a progress. Adds that there is a single change.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women is in for a chat. She says that the surface is hard. Adds today is a great opportunity for the batters to express themselves. Informs that there is a single change to the side

Ireland Women (Playing XI) - Amy Hunter, Gaby Lewis, Orla Prendergast, Laura Delany (C), Eimear Richardson, Louise Little, Mary Waldron (WK), Leah Paul, Arlene Kelly, Cara Murray, Georgina Dempsey (In for Jane Maguire).

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Devika Vaidya (In for Radha Yadav), Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh, Shikha Pandey.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of India Women. They will BAT first.

Ireland Women have not won any game so far in the tournament, and they are looking forward to ending the team’s group stage campaign with a win. They are already out of the tournament and they have nothing to lose which makes them dangerous. They have showed glimpses of their quality in both batting and bowling departments, and this experience would help them in future events. However, they would be hoping to cause an upset and end their World Cup on a high. Will they be able to do it? Or will India Women prove to be too strong for them? Let's find out together. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

After winning the first two games of the tournament against Pakistan Women and West Indies women, India Women lost the last game against England Women. Now, to get back on a winning track again, they will face a struggling Irish side in their last group stage match. They let the game against England Women slip away from them with a lack of team effort which they would like to overcome here and confirm their qualification to the next round. They have the better side on paper and if they play to their strengths this should be a comfortable win for them.

Hello and a warm welcome folks! It is almost time for Match 18 of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup, India Women are facing Ireland Women at St George's Park in Gqeberha. Indian side are just a win away from qualifying for the knockout stage of the World cup hence it will be a crucial game for them. Ireland Women are in a nothing to lose situation and will try to be a hurdle in front of Team India.
... MATCH DAY ...
